query:
-- Senate races in May 19 states
SELECT 'Senate' as chamber, state_code, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, 
       status, primary_winner, primary_party, pct_reporting, notes
FROM senate_races
WHERE state_code IN ('GA','KY','OR','PA','WV','NE','ID')
ORDER BY state_code;

rows.notes: Incumbent Jon Ossoff (D) running for re-election. R primary May 19: Earl Carter ($6.2M raised), Mike Collins ($3.3M), Derek Dooley ($3M), John Coyne, Jonathan McColumn. Cook/IE: Toss-up. Sabato: Lean D.
Incumbent Jim Risch (R) seeking re-election. Primary May 19, 2026.

Open seat — Mitch McConnell (R) retiring after 40 years. Republican primary: Andy Barr (Trump-endorsed, incumbent KY-6 rep) vs Daniel Cameron (former AG) and 9 others. Democratic primary: Charles Booker (progressive, prior Senate candidate) vs Amy McGrath (ran vs McConnell 2020), Dale Romans, Pamela Stevenson, and others. Kentucky is R+26; rated Solid R by all outlets.

Incumbent Pete Ricketts (R) running for re-election. D primary May 12: Cindy Burbank, William Forbes. Dan Osborn (I) also running in general. R primary May 12: Ricketts + challengers. Cook/IE/Sabato: Likely R.

Incumbent Jeff Merkley (D) seeking his 3rd term. Primary May 19, 2026. Republican primary features 7 candidates including Jo Rae Perkins (2020 and 2022 GOP nominee) and David Brock Smith (state rep). Merkley won 2020 with 56.9%. Rated Solid D by all outlets.
Incumbent Shelley Moore Capito (R) seeking re-election. Primary May 12, 2026.
